description: Temporal workflow code must be fully deterministic — no datetime.now, random, uuid4, time, os.getenv, file I/O, HTTP, or asyncio.sleep
scope: modules/backend/temporal/*workflow*.py (workflow files only; activities and worker are exempt)
fix: Move all side effects into Activities; use workflow.now()/workflow.sleep()/workflow.uuid4() for time, sleep, and randomness inside workflow code. Non-determinism causes silent replay divergence under failure recovery. Enforced by scripts/code_rules_fast.py check_temporal_determinism.
